subject: Genetics
title: Shotgun vs. Map-First
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Shotgun vs. Map-First.

hook.text: Two strategies to read the genome. One builds a map first, then reads. The other reads first and sorts later.

buildup.text: The public project mapped chromosome positions before sequencing. Methodical but slow. Quality guaranteed.

discovery.text: Celera's shotgun approach skipped mapping. It shattered DNA randomly and used algorithms to rebuild order.

twist.text: Shotgun sequencing relied on Celera secretly using public project data to anchor its assembly. Not fully independent.

climax.text: Both approaches worked. Modern sequencing combines elements of each. The debate drove innovation on both sides.

punchline.text: Two rival methods built the same answer.

quiz.question: What did Celera's shotgun approach skip that the public project did first?
